text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey you. You came at just the right 
time.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... I haven't gotten to bite anyone 
yet today, so I was feeling super 
grumpy... Hehehe, now let me take a big 
chomp...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Yield quietly and let Windy-chan 
catch you—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's totally boring if you just let 
yourself get caught so quietly!! Act more 
scared~~!
